title: The Real Impact of FinTech: Evidence from Mobile Payment Technology
authors: Sumit D. Agarwal; Wenlan Qian; Yuan Ren; Hsin‐Tien Tsai; Bernard Yin Yeung
eligible_reason: Single common adoption date. The QR-code payment event is dated April 2017 for every unit: analysis_business_creation.do line 85 gen post=yearmonth>=201704, treatpost = treatment*post (treatment = industries exposed to QR payments, ind4 level); analysis_consumer.do line 66 postevent=yearmonth>=201704 with treatment = consumers who adopted PayLah by 201703. ATM analysis (analysis_atm.do) is cross-sectional (close_after_event on ATM characteristics). No staggered timing anywhere.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. Business creation: firm counts per 4-digit industry x month, absorb(ind4 ym ind2#year), cluster ind4, static and event-time (pre3..post12) versions; consumer panel: individual x month, PSM 1:1 matched sample, absorb(id yearmonth); ATM: OLS of closure/opening on location characteristics.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: All treated units switch on in April 2017 (yearmonth 201704).
data_files_note: DataDisclosure.docx: ACRA registry and DBS bank data under confidentiality agreements; acra_firm.dta, consumer.dta, psm.dta, atm.dta not provided (stored at ZJU for on-site replication). Package ships only do files, logs and docx.
data_provenance_note: No data files in the archive.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Common-date DiD around the 2017 QR-code introduction in Singapore; not staggered; data not shipped.
